explanation: The result is injectivity of the self-dependent update map λ ↦ Function.update λ row (λ row + 1). I searched Mathlib’s Function.update lemmas, including Function.update_injective in Mathlib/Logic/Function/Basic.lean; that lemma only proves injectivity when the function being updated is fixed, so it does not state this result. The current proof uses pointwise equality, splitting on whether the index is row, and Nat.add_right_cancel; I found no single Mathlib declaration carrying the full result.
